items.text: DAY 6. Three tickets, same weight today. No easy one to start on.

items.title: THREE STUBS, SAME PRICE
body: Found three ticket stubs stapled together this morning. Same intake fee, same parts estimate, same turnaround. Rhea swears she did not do it on purpose.
She prices by tier, not by feel, she says. I believe her. I also watched her circle the total twice before she filed it.
The Meridian statement was under the stack. The balance did not move this month. It also did not shrink.
